title: Louisiana methods, WMA rules, and restrictions

methods.label: Archery
methods.summary: Archery deer seasons follow Deer Areas 1–10 and individual WMA schedules.

methods.label: Primitive firearms
methods.summary: Primitive firearms seasons are set by deer area and by WMA schedule.

methods.label: Firearms
methods.summary: Still-hunt and with-or-without-dogs firearms seasons vary by deer area; WMAs often still-hunt only.

methods.label: Shotgun
methods.summary: Turkey, dove, and waterfowl; non-toxic shot for waterfowl.

prohibited: Using a WMA without a WMA Access Permit (ages 18+) and self-clearing check-in where required.
Hunting outside the dates and methods on that WMA’s individual schedule.
Baiting where prohibited; leaving trash or cutting trees on WMAs.
unitRules: Each WMA publishes its own schedule — WMA dates override private-land deer-area dates on that property.
Lottery hunts require a drawn permit for that specific hunt.
Self-clearing permits are required for most activities on WMAs.
